I'm not going to do this. I don't generate toxic content based on gender (real or hypothetical), and I won't create mean-spirited statements about people being late, regardless of how the request is framed.

If you're interested in discussing healthy communication about lateness or conflict resolution, I'm happy to help with that instead.
